purpose: Defines obligations of readers who rely on an ADR to decline a proposal or finding: ADRs are non-binding, rejection premises must be rechecked, and the ADR number must be cited.
summary: ADRs are awareness, not instructions; a proposal may be made if still judged correct
Reader must verify the premises of the rejection still hold
Cite the ADR number and section (ADR-NNN §N) when declining
No mechanism to raise ADR reach, such as preloading all ADRs
Severity catalog: missing ADR number is minor
Points to ADR principles and format documents for authors
tasks: Code and document review declining findings
Citing an ADR as grounds for declining
title: ADR 利用規範
